research_mode: official web sources only; methodology and runtime integrity guards; no target parcel result claimed

sources.name: Locate a neighbourhood API contract
verified_claims: accepts a latitude-longitude pair
returns a unique force identifier and force-specific neighbourhood identifier
limitations: neighbourhood assignment is a policing-team crosscheck and not an LSOA containment result
the returned team ID must remain paired with its force

sources.name: Crimes at a location API contract
verified_claims: latitude-longitude requests resolve to the nearest predefined map location
requests accept an explicit YYYY-MM month or a location_id
persistent_id is the durable 64-character crime identifier while API id is not guaranteed stable
limitations: nearest predefined location is not an exact parcel incident location
returned coordinates and street names remain approximate

sources.name: Specific neighbourhood identifier scope contract
verified_claims: neighbourhood IDs are police-force-specific
a neighbourhood ID is not globally unique and can be reused by another force
the reported centre point may not be the exact centre of the neighbourhood
limitations: neighbourhood population and centre are not substitutes for ONS LSOA population or geometry

sources.name: Police recorded crime geographic reference table contract
verified_claims: the geographic reference table maps CSP name to police force area region and a unique ONS code
reference values are intended to validate the corresponding main-table fields
limitations: CSP and police-force-area geography is broader than an LSOA or parcel

sources.name: Police recorded crime offence reference table contract
verified_claims: the offence reference table maps offence codes to descriptions
it distinguishes old pre-July-2013 and new post-July-2013 offence groups and sub-groups
limitations: classification changes must be edition-aware and cannot be silently merged across periods

sources.name: PFA and CSP aggregation and British Transport Police scope rules
verified_claims: open-data figures are published at PFA and CSP level
quarterly figures are additive for constructing a twelve-month PFA total
British Transport Police data are excluded from CSP-level totals
quarterly data can be revised after transfers or cancellations
limitations: PFA or CSP totals are not parcel measurements

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing Communities and Local Government
sources.name: IoD25 File 7 schema and corrected v2 lookup requirement
verified_claims: File 7 is the official CSV containing all ranks scores deciles and population denominators
Files 1 to 9 were corrected after an ONS LSOA-to-LAD lookup allocation error
users are instructed to use the updated v2 files
limitations: the correction changed lookup allocation rather than the underlying deprivation data
only one current v2 row per matched LSOA may be promoted

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing Communities and Local Government
sources.name: IoD25 domain weighting contract
verified_claims: Crime has a 9.3 percent weight in the overall Index of Multiple Deprivation
the published domain weights reflect methodological robustness and literature review
limitations: the 9.3 percent weight is an IMD construction weight and not a parcel safety probability or confidence score

sources.name: May 2026 complete archive and MD5 integrity record
verified_claims: the current archive listed is May 2026 and is 1.6 GB
it contains data from June 2023 through May 2026
the published MD5 is 9a1dcd49501f489bba3132c6f98c13fa
the page states that all but the latest archive are out of date for normal use
limitations: the archive still requires download and local checksum verification before row use
MD5 verifies transfer identity and is not a data-quality score
